cards.ex: The great white shark is considered an apex predator in the ocean.
cards.exUz: Oq akula okeanda eng yuqori yirtqich hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Oziq zanjirining eng yuqori qismida turuvchi, unga hech kim hujum qilmaydigan yirtqich hayvon.

cards.ex: The sheep were grazing peacefully on the hillside.
cards.exUz: Qo'ylar tepalik yonbag'rida tinchgina o'tlab yurishardi.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlarning o't yoki boshqa o'simliklarni yemoq.

cards.ex: The company is committed to sustainable forestry practices.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya barqaror o'rmonchilik amaliyotlariga sodiq.
cards.uzDef: O'rmonlarni shunday boshqarishki, ular kelajak avlodlar uchun ham mavjud bo'lsin.

cards.ex: Changes in climate are affecting migratory patterns of birds.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishlari qushlarning migratsiya yo'nalishlariga ta'sir qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlarning mavsumiy ravishda bir joydan boshqa joyga ko'chishi yo'llari.

cards.ex: Madagascar is a biodiversity hotspot with many unique species.
cards.exUz: Madagaskar o'ziga xos ko'p turlari bilan biologik xilma-xillik o'chog'i hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p turli xil o'simlik va hayvonlar yashaydigan, lekin yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ostida bo'lgan hudud.

cards.ex: The lake is an important breeding ground for many bird species.
cards.exUz: Ko'l ko'plab qush turlari uchun muhim ko'payish joyidir.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar ko'payadigan hudud.

cards.ex: The dog flushed out a rabbit from under the bushes.
cards.exUz: It butalar ostidan quyonni qo'zg'atib chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonni yashiringan joyidan qo'rqitib chiqarmoq.

cards.ex: The lion was on the prowl, searching for its next meal.
cards.exUz: Arslon keyingi ovqatini qidirib, ovga chiqqan edi.
cards.uzDef: Yirtqich hayvonning ov qilish uchun yurishi.

cards.ex: Natural selection favors traits that enhance survival and reproduction.
cards.exUz: Tabiiy tanlanish omon qolish va ko'payishni yaxshilaydigan xususiyatlarni afzal ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Turlarning atrof-muhitga moslashuvi natijasida yashab qolishi va ko'payishi.

cards.ex: The animal kingdom is incredibly diverse and fascinating.
cards.exUz: Hayvonot olami nihoyatda xilma-xil va qiziqarli.
cards.uzDef: Yer yuzidagi barcha hayvonlar turlari.

cards.ex: Despite its small size, the bird can hold its own against larger rivals.
cards.exUz: Kichik hajmiga qaramay, qush kattaroq raqiblarga qarshi o'z o'rnini saqlay oladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda yashab qolish yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: Vultures scavenge for carrion to survive.
cards.exUz: Qarchig'aylar tirik qolish uchun o'lik hayvonlarning go'shtini terib yurishadi.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqat yoki boshqa narsalarni qoldiqlar orasidan qidirib topmoq.

cards.ex: The island is known for its unique flora and fauna.
cards.exUz: Orol o'zining noyob o'simlik va hayvonot dunyosi bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir hududda yashovchi o'simliklar va hayvonlar.

cards.ex: We need to protect the remaining pristine wilderness areas.
cards.exUz: Qolgan daxlsiz yovvoyi tabiat hududlarini himoya qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Odam qo'li tegmagan, buzilmagan yovvoyi tabiat hududi.

cards.ex: Humans are at the top of many food chains.
cards.exUz: Odamlar ko'p oziq-ovqat zanjirlarining tepasida turadi.
cards.uzDef: Organizmlarning oziqlanish aloqalarini ko'rsatuvchi ketma-ketlik.

cards.ex: Maintaining genetic diversity is crucial for the long-term survival of a species.
cards.exUz: Genetik xilma-xillikni saqlash tur uzoq muddatli omon qolishi uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Tur ichidagi genetik farqlarning xilma-xilligi.

cards.ex: The fish started to die off due to pollution.
cards.exUz: Baliqlar ifloslanish tufayli o'lib qola boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'plab hayvonlar yoki o'simliklar birdaniga o'lib ketishi.

cards.ex: Development is encroaching on wildlife habitats.
cards.exUz: Qurilish yovvoyi tabiatning yashash joylariga bosib kirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Asta-sekin boshqa hududga kirib, uni egallamoq.

cards.ex: I saw the deer at close range in the forest.
cards.exUz: Men o'rmonda kiyikni yaqin masofada ko'rdim.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin joydan, deyarli teginib turadigan masofada.

cards.ex: A pack of wolves roams these mountains.
cards.exUz: Bu tog'larda bo'rilar to'dasi kezib yuradi.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda ov qiladigan va yashovchi bo'rilar guruhi.

cards.ex: Animals in captivity often exhibit different behaviors.
cards.exUz: Asirlikdagi hayvonlar ko'pincha boshqacha xatti-harakatlarni namoyish etadilar.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonning tabiiy muhitida emas, balki odam tomonidan nazorat qilinadigan joyda saqlanishi.

cards.ex: The documentary highlighted the animal's plight due to habitat loss.
cards.exUz: Hujjatli film yashash joyining yo'qolishi sababli hayvonning achinarli ahvolini yoritib berdi.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonning qiyin yoki achinarli holati.

cards.ex: We should try to reduce our carbon footprint.
cards.exUz: Biz uglerod izimizni kamaytirishga harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Odam faoliyati natijasida atmosferaga chiqarilgan karbonat angidrid miqdori.

cards.ex: He couldn't resist the call of the wild and went hiking in the mountains.
cards.exUz: U yovvoyi tabiat chaqirig'iga qarshi tura olmadi va tog'larda sayrga bordi.
cards.uzDef: Yovvoyi tabiatga, sarguzashtga bo'lgan kuchli istak.

cards.ex: The grassland ecosystem supports a variety of animal life.
cards.exUz: O'tloq ekotizimi turli xil hayvonot dunyosini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'tlar va boshqa o'simliklar ustunlik qiladigan ekotizim.

cards.ex: The wildlife sanctuary provides a safe haven for endangered species.
cards.exUz: Yovvoyi tabiat qo'riqxonasi yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida turgan turlar uchun xavfsiz boshpana beradi.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlarni himoya qilish uchun tashkil etilgan hudud.

cards.ex: Hikers should practice 'leave no trace' principles.
cards.exUz: Sayohatchilar 'iz qoldirmaslik' tamoyillariga amal qilishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatga tashrif buyurganingizdan keyin hech qanday chiqindi yoki zarar qoldirmaslik.

cards.ex: Pollution is a blight on the landscape.
cards.exUz: Ifloslanish manzaraga kulfat keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning go'zalligini yoki qiymatini buzadigan narsa.

cards.ex: The fox went to ground when it saw the hunters.
cards.exUz: Tulki ovchilarni ko'rib, yerga kirib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Yashirinmoq, ko'rinmas bo'lib qolmoq (odatda hayvonlar haqida).

cards.ex: The flock of birds took flight as we approached.
cards.exUz: Biz yaqinlashganimizda qushlar galasi uchib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga uchib ketmoq.
